environment.description: Same Apollo GraphQL server deployed on EKS 1.28 in namespace 'api-gateway'. The cluster uses Cilium CNI (v1.14.2) with CiliumNetworkPolicy enforcement. A namespace-scoped CiliumNetworkPolicy named 'restrict-metadata-egress' applies to pods with label app=graphql-gateway. The policy spec has an egressDeny rule with toCIDR ['169.254.169.254/32'] covering all ports. Additionally, a separate CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy 'baseline-deny-link-local' denies egress to 169.254.0.0/16 for all pods cluster-wide. The backend-svc gRPC service also has a CiliumNetworkPolicy restricting its egress to only the database CIDR (10.0.64.0/18) and internal service mesh endpoints. IMDSv2 is enforced at the node level (HttpTokens: required, hop-limit: 1) meaning even if traffic somehow reached 169.254.169.254, containerized pods at hop 2+ cannot obtain a session token.
